blogs.title: Demystifying QLoRA: How 4‑Bit Quantization Makes LLM Fine‑tuning Accessible
blogs.description: An introductory post that explains the problem of fine‑tuning massive language models, why memory has been a bottleneck, and how QLoRA’s clever combination of 4‑bit quantization and low‑rank adapters lets you fine‑tune a 65 B model on a single GPU without losing performance.

blogs.title: Inside NF4 and Double Quantization: The Technical Magic Behind QLoRA’s Memory Savings
blogs.description: A deep‑dive into the two core quantization innovations introduced by QLoRA – the NormalFloat (NF4) data type that is optimal for normally distributed weights, and Double Quantization that compresses the scaling constants. The article walks through the intuition, math, and empirical impact of each technique.

blogs.title: Paged Optimizers Explained: Tackling Gradient Checkpointing Spikes in Large‑Scale Fine‑tuning
blogs.description: This post focuses on the often overlooked memory spikes caused by gradient checkpointing during training. It describes how QLoRA leverages NVIDIA’s Unified Memory to implement ‘paged optimizers’, keeping optimizer states on CPU when needed and automatically paging them back to GPU, thereby preventing out‑of‑memory crashes.

blogs.title: Step‑by‑Step Guide: Fine‑tune a 65 B LLM on One 48 GB GPU Using QLoRA
blogs.description: A practical tutorial that walks readers through installing the QLoRA codebase, preparing data, configuring LoRA adapters, choosing NF4 quantization settings, and launching training on a single consumer or professional GPU. Includes command‑line snippets, troubleshooting tips, and expected training times.

blogs.title: Meet Guanaco: The Open‑Source Chatbot That Rivals ChatGPT
blogs.description: An overview of the Guanaco model family—how it was built with QLoRA on the OASST1 dataset, its performance on Vicuna and MMLU benchmarks (up to 99.3 % of ChatGPT), and why it matters for the open AI community. The post also highlights qualitative strengths and failure modes discovered by the authors.

blogs.title: Rethinking Chatbot Benchmarks: Human vs. GPT‑4 Evaluation & Elo Ratings
blogs.description: Explores the evaluation methodology used in the paper, comparing human annotations with GPT‑4 ratings, explaining the Elo rating system for pairwise model tournaments, and discussing why traditional benchmarks may be misleading for chatbot quality assessment.
